headline: GTA 6 pre-order bonus
title: GTA 6 Pre-Order Bonus | Vintage Vice City Pack + Free GTA Plus Month | GTA 6 News
video_script: Pre-ordering GTA six? Here is what you get. Every pre-order and every purchase before November twentieth includes the Vintage Vice City Pack. Digital pre-orders also get one free month of GTA plus. The Standard Edition is seventy nine ninety nine dollars, and the Ultimate Edition is ninety nine ninety nine. Which edition are you buying? Comment below!
description: GTA 6 pre-orders and purchases before November 20 include the Vintage Vice City Pack; digital pre-orders add a free month of GTA+. Standard $79.99, Ultimate $99.99 (US).
